gen-indie-flower-fs-amulya: Amulya reads low and modern, its curves leaving generous gaps. Indie Flower is best for a line or two of loose, hand-drawn warmth, while Amulya, a sans-serif, does the steadier work of staying out of the way.
gen-indie-flower-fs-bespoke-sans: Sharp and refined, Bespoke Sans leaves generous space beside each stem. Bespoke Sans handles the crisp work while Indie Flower, its lines holding width through every turn, adds a loose hand, good for a few lines.
gen-indie-flower-fs-literata: Hand-drawn warmth up top, bookish polish below. Indie Flower's rounded, cord-cut strokes loosen up Literata's sturdy hairlines and gentle weight shifts, a mix better kept brief.
gen-indie-flower-fs-recia: Recia reads sharp and authoritative, its modulation subtle until you look closely. Indie Flower is at its best relaxed and smooth at the joins, while Recia does its best work in gentle bowls, pleasant in modest helpings.
gen-instrument-serif-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Rivets and razors: Instrument Serif packs fat bars against fine threads. Be Vietnam Pro, a sans-serif with curve endings kept well apart, is the open space that makes the dense heading hit harder.
gen-instrument-serif-fs-public-sans: Sharp drama, sturdy footing: Instrument Serif's fat bars and fine threads lead. Public Sans, a sans-serif with a hefty lowercase and broad counters, holds the page steady under that theatrical heading.
gen-instrument-serif-montserrat: Instrument Serif sets fat bars beside hairline threads, rivet-tight and dramatic. Montserrat's oversized e and a counters let the eye glide along like wire, so extended reading feels light, never cramped.
gen-irish-grover-gf-noto-sans-syriac-eas: Noto Sans Syriac Eastern is a friendly, contemporary sans. Irish Grover brings sturdy tall words and softly varied strokes, and the body's curve endings, kept well apart, keep the mood tidy.
gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-bespoke-slab: Bespoke Slab reads grounded and refined, with tall bodies in every lowercase letter. JetBrains Mono's marker-like line and fixed-width, code-style letters feel brisk beside it, loosely strung and a touch technical.
gen-jetbrains-mono-fs-hind: Contemporary and code-flavored, JetBrains Mono strings its fixed-width letters loosely. And Hind, whose lowercase nearly matches its capitals, can be given a little extra size without losing its drawn-string steadiness.
